whyItWorks: It sells a place in the order a guest imagines it: arrival, legend, surroundings in walking minutes, life there, rooms, proof, invitation — with one recognisable motif and a calm two-tone earth palette.
principles: Order the hotel story as arrival → legend → surroundings → experiences → rooms → book.
Express distances as 'N min. walk to X' cards next to a simple line map.
Use one proprietary motif (from the building or region) for loader, dividers and transitions.
Two earth tones + white over imagery; serif numerals as heroes.
Keep a consultation/booking CTA reappearing in every chapter.

implementationNotes: Next.js + Tailwind: sections as server components; stripe motif as an SVG pattern (repeating <rect>s with CSS-var heights) animated with GSAP ScrollTrigger scrub on transform: scaleY — no canvas needed; distance cards = static data + CSS scroll-snap carousel; room tabs = client component with aria-selected tabs; header always visible (sticky) with Book CTA; preloader only if fonts/hero image not cached, max ≈1 s, skipped under prefers-reduced-motion.
